### The Law of God Recovered
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/law-of-god-recovered
Passage: 2 Kings 22:13
Points:
- Severe spiritual decline under Manasseh and Amon was interrupted when young King Josiah sought to do what was right.
- While temple repairs were underway, priests recovered the long-neglected Book of the Law.
- Hearing God's Word exposed the nation's apostasy, driving Josiah to tear his clothes in grief and repentance.
- Josiah sent leaders to inquire of the Lord regarding the divine judgment threatened against Judah's disobedience.
- God demonstrated mercy by delaying the covenant curse of exile because of Josiah's faithful, humble response.
